result.title: From Generic to Dedicated: A Novel Optimizer for Online Continual Learning
result.summary: Online Continual Learning (OCL) requires models to learn from non-stationary data streams under a strict single-pass constraint, making them highly susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. While existing studies have explored various strategies from data, architecture, and optimization perspectives, the optimizer often directly uses generic approaches such as SGD and AdamW. In this work, we reveal a new link between optimization dynamics and OCL needs by recasting Polyak-Ruppert averaging as the engine of "plasticity" and Primal averaging as the anchor of "stability". This inspires our novel optimizer, SPIN (Stability-Plasticity INterpolation), which explicitly decouples plasticity and stability by interpolating between a fast-moving "plasticity" sequence and an adaptive "stability" sequence. We theoretically demonstrate that SPIN implicitly employs an inverse Hessian approximation, providing crucial Tikhonov regularization to damp noisy, single-sample Hessian estimates and mitigate forgetting. More importantly, SPIN can be seamlessly integrated into existing OCL methods by taking resulted gradients as input and replacing standard optimizers. Extensive experiments show that using SPIN instead of standard optimizers yields consistent and significant performance gains across multiple OCL approaches, including the challenging rehearsal-free setting and under strict memory constraints.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对 online continual learning 中优化器仍沿用 SGD/AdamW 的现状，提出 SPIN 优化器：用 Polyak-Ruppert 平均对应「可塑性」序列、Primal 平均对应「稳定性」序列，在两者间插值以解耦稳定性与可塑性，并论证其隐含逆 Hessian 近似与 Tikhonov 正则，可直接替换现有 OCL 方法的优化器。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「快变可塑性序列 + 自适应稳定序列」的梯度级插值与噪声抑制，可供核查是否能用于 LVR/VLM 推理的序贯或持续训练，以缓解对噪声轨迹监督的过拟合与能力遗忘。
